title: Georgian for Garmin font registry
description: Garmin stock font packs that get Georgian glyphs, the font the glyphs come from, the watch models each pack was verified on, and the support list: every watch model the project knows of.

georgian_font.description: The TrueType font the Georgian glyphs are rendered from, and its license.

watches.description: The support list: every watch model the project knows of, with its GitHub issues and, for a model known not to work, why. A model's status on a connected watch (tested, expected, beta, unsupported, unknown) is derived from this, the packs' tested entries and install settings, and the fonts the watch lists.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, 64 lowercase hex digits.

earlier_georgian.description: Georgian builds of this part that earlier releases installed (the beta test marks), so a newer build recognizes them as its own: inspect reports them as georgian_beta, and install and restore replace them.

part_number.description: A Garmin part number, such as 006-D9035-03.

pack.description: One stock font family: a bitmap pack in all the sizes Garmin publishes it in, or a TrueType family in its weights.

id.description: Stable identifier: lowercase words joined by hyphens.

name.description: Garmin's product name for the pack, as its update catalog shows it.

kind.description: bitmap: Garmin's 2-bit .fnt fonts, staged on the watch as <part>.tmp. truetype: Garmin's masked TrueType .bin fonts, which the watch keeps as GARMIN/ExtData/<part>.bin.

weight.description: The weight the pack's stock glyphs are drawn at; Georgian is drawn at it too.

install.description: Which builds install this pack's Georgian: true (default) every build; "beta" only pre-release builds, for a pack that didn't render on a watch and is being retested; false none. Every build still restores Garmin's original and recognizes the pack's Georgian builds.

issue.description: The GitHub issue where the pack is being tested; required with install "beta". The app links it for a watch this pack would install on only in a beta build.

tested.description: Watches on which the Georgian build was installed and rendered Georgian.

part.description: One size of a bitmap pack: a stock .fnt file on Garmin's download server.

size_px.description: Nominal pixel size, about the height of the part's capitals. Georgian is sized by measuring the stock glyphs, not by this value.

version.description: Garmin's release version of the file, as in its footer (2.10).

url.description: The official download URL from Garmin's update catalog.

weight.description: The weight this part's stock glyphs are drawn at, where it differs from the pack's.

truetype_part.description: One font of a TrueType pack: a stock masked TrueType .bin file on Garmin's download server.

version.description: Garmin's release version of the file, as its update catalog and the watch's GarminDevice.xml list it (2.00).

url.description: The official download URL from Garmin's update catalog.

weight.description: The weight this font's stock glyphs are drawn at, where it differs from the pack's.

issue.description: A GitHub issue number in lubaretsi/georgian-for-garmin.

software.description: A watch software version, Model/SoftwareVersion with two decimals (19.05).

watch.description: A watch model in the support list.

model.description: The model's name for people, as the README's watch table shows it (Venu 2; fenix 7 Pro Solar, Pro Sapphire Solar for two descriptions of one part number).

model_part.description: The watch's own part number (GarminDevice.xml Model/PartNumber); unique in the list.

issues.description: GitHub issues about this model, the main one first: the one its owners follow for updates, where duplicates are closed into.

unsupported.description: The model is known not to work. A report from it adds information only on a software version not listed here.

software.description: Software versions it was reported on.

reason.description: Why, in each language of the app.

weight.description: A Noto Sans Georgian weight, as a value on its wght axis: 400 Regular, 700 Bold.

model_part.description: The watch's own part number (GarminDevice.xml Model/PartNumber); the model must be in watches.

software.description: The watch's software version during the test (19.05).

parts.description: Parts of this pack seen rendering Georgian on that watch.
